evaluation_basis: Assessed as an audit-only diagnostic. It changes neither signals nor thresholds nor promotion gates, and its rankings cannot authorize a candidate.
original_objective: Measure concurrent positions, gross exposure and concentration for every frozen candidate under corrected causal settlement timing.

engineering_result.summary: Portfolio exposure metrics, candidate rankings, immutable decision output, focused tests and an artifact-producing workflow are implemented.

scientific_result.summary: The code explicitly prevents exposure rankings from relaxing the 5% drawdown gate or becoming a post-hoc promotion rule.

economic_result.summary: Exposure measurement can explain risk but does not itself demonstrate positive net out-of-sample expectancy or authorize forward PAPER.

limitations: Audit reuses consumed v0.20 historical evidence
Risk attribution is not causal alpha proof
Canonical run identifiers absent from reviewed record
contribution_to_next_version: Provided portfolio diagnostics needed to compare the explicit allocator against v0.23 earliest-first acceptance in v0.25.
